proof_boundary: This receipt records that the formal Lean 4 module type-checks without error and which axioms its #print axioms lines report. The outcome is Reduced: uniqueness of the inner product on the sector carrier is reduced to two supplied hypotheses on the quadratic readout (sector additivity on disjoint supports and transitive sector symmetry under permutation relabelling). When sector labels are distinguished, symmetry collapses to orbit-constant diagonal without enforcing global scalar uniqueness.
